This plant can be found in moist woodland, often at higher altitudes, throughout temperate areas of Europe, Asia, and eastern and western North America. The arecatannin-type natural products from Ceylonese cassia bark and Areca seed are examples polyphenols by both current definitions, and fit the distinct definition of a polymeric phenol as well.

It is the only national natural areas program that identifies and recognizes the best examples of biological and geological features in both public and private ownership.  The program was established on May 18, 1962, by United States Secretary of the Interior Stewart Udall.

3. **Hop 3: Verification of "Natural Categorization".** The term "natural categorization" in taxonomy refers to systems that reflect evolutionary relationships (phylogenetics) rather than artificial groupings. The claim identifies two legitimate biological genera and posits them as examples of natural categorization (biological classification), which is factually accurate in a scientific taxonomy context.

Research done by chemical biologists is often closer related to that of cell biology than biochemistry.  Biochemists study the chemistry of biomolecules and regulation of biochemical pathways within cells and tissues, e.g. cAMP or cGMP, while chemical biologists deal with novel chemical compounds "applied to" biology.
Lead compound | A lead compound (i.e. a "leading" compound, not lead metal) in drug discovery is a chemical compound that has pharmacological or biological activity likely to be therapeutically useful, but may still have suboptimal structure that requires modification to fit better to the target. Furthermore, newly invented pharmacologically active moieties may have poor druglikeness and may require chemical modification to become drug-like enough to be tested biologically or clinically.
